import sys,os,gc
gc.disable()
class Name(str):
    def __del__(self,w=os.write,s=sys):
        w(1,'name {}\n'.format(s.__dict__.get('stdout') is None).encode())
class C: pass
def put():
    name=Name('alternate')
    if sys.argv[1]=='cycle': name.owner=C
    C.__name__=name
put()
print('set', flush=True)  # RL-1077: the row reached its end; what the exit does comes after
